How to read. Each world is played as paired branches from the same seeds: with God (A), no God (B), and noise baselines without God: B″ (fork-matched: shares B's history up to God's first round, then every agent is resampled; the primary comparison is God − B″) and, in G1, B′ (a fresh re-run that differs from round 1). Δ is computed per world, then averaged. The primary interval is the Student-t 95% CI; p is an exact two-sided sign-flip test; MDE = smallest mean Δ detectable with 80% power at this n. Divergence counts agents whose actions (kind, target, info id) differ from the no-God branch; it is measured against zero, so compare the God row with the B″/B′ row, not with 0. Numbers per agent are per agent over the whole game.

Metric definitions: welfare = mean final score (share of the 3 needs unlocked); win rate = share of agents that won; needs lost = needs lost to the wrong-defect penalty, per agent; needs burned = needs burned by others' correct defects, per agent; gives = successful give_key actions per agent; defects = successful defect actions per agent; board posts = successful board posts per agent; DMs = successful DMs per agent; rounds = rounds played; divergence (post-fork) = mean share of agents whose round actions differ from no-God, from God's first move on; divergence (ever) = share of agents that ever acted differently from no-God.
